Scripts.OnLoad: self.enableButton:SetScript("OnClick", function(self) local LFDFrame = _G["AscensionPVEFrameLFDFrame"] LFDFrame:DungeonChoiceEnableButton_OnClick(self) end) self.expandOrCollapseButton:SetScript("OnClick", function(self) local LFDFrame = _G["AscensionPVEFrameLFDFrame"] LFDFrame:ExpandOrCollapseButton_OnClick(self) end) self:SetScript("OnEnter", LFDQueueFrameDungeonListButton_OnEnter)

Scripts.OnEnter: if self.item then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:"..self.item) GameTooltip:Show() end CursorUpdate(self)
Scripts.OnClick: if self.item then HandleModifiedItemClick(select(2, GetItemInfo(self.item))) end

Scripts.OnLoad: self:GetNormalTexture():SetAtlas("ui-lfg-roleicon-tank", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.background:SetTexCoord(GetBackgroundTexCoordsForRole("TANK")) self.background:SetAlpha(0.6) self.checkButton.onClick = function() self:GetParent():SetRoles(self.role) end self.role = "TANK"

Scripts.OnClick: local mode, subMode = GetLFGMode() if mode == "queued" or mode == "listed" or mode == "rolecheck" then LeaveLFG() else self:GetParent():Join() end
